## Positioning

Evgeny Shtein is a hands-on engineering leader in cybersecurity and AI-driven platforms. His background spans endpoint security, SaaS platforms, cloud operations, DevOps, FinOps, Android framework, embedded systems, Windows, macOS, Linux, and security engineering.

He is presented as a leader who builds teams from the inside: close to the engineers, part of the execution loop, supportive of healthy team culture, and focused on creating a workplace people want to be part of.

## Leadership Themes

- Leads big international engineering teams
- Creates supportive working environments
- Builds strong engineering culture and trust
- Promotes balanced work-life expectations
- Improves infrastructure and reduces cost
- Embeds AI and agentic AI into engineering workflows
- Aligns architecture, product, delivery, and operations
